plugins.name: skills
plugins.description: A collection of software-engineering skills for Claude Code — code review, spec-driven implementation, bug diagnosis, domain modeling, and more. Based on Matt Pocock's skills (https://github.com/mattpocock/skills). Includes pstack, Lauren Tan's (poteto) agent methodology, imported from Michael Denyer's Claude Code port (https://github.com/michael-denyer/pstack-claude).
